callees.name: State
callees.pre_condition: proj_dir is a non-empty string path to an existing directory.
callees.post_condition: Returns a State instance whose trace_dir attribute resolves to the fm_agent/trace/ subdirectory under proj_dir. The instance holds empty in-memory collections for events, opencode trace data, and bug summaries, ready for subsequent tail_events, tail_opencode, and scan_bugs calls.

callees.name: State.tail_events
callees.pre_condition: self.trace_dir exists and contains a trace/events.jsonl file (possibly empty or absent after first tail).
callees.post_condition: Appends all newly arrived structured trace event entries from events.jsonl (since the last tail_events call) into the in-memory event list. Event order is preserved as read from the file.

callees.name: State.tail_opencode
callees.pre_condition: self.trace_dir exists and may contain an opencode/ subdirectory with raw LLM request/response JSONL files.
callees.post_condition: Reads any newly written raw OpenCode LLM trace records from the opencode/ subdirectory and updates internal counters — including the aggregate cache_window as a collection of (cached_tokens, total_input_tokens) pairs — to reflect the cumulative token usage across all OpenCode subprocess calls recorded so far.

callees.name: State.scan_bugs
callees.pre_condition: self.trace_dir exists and may contain a bug_validation/ subdirectory with per-bug Markdown reports and an optional summary.json.
callees.post_condition: Reads all currently available bug validation reports and the aggregate summary from the bug_validation/ subdirectory. Updates in-memory bug verdict counts and status summaries to reflect the latest confirmed, unconfirmed, and total bug statistics.

callees.name: build_layout
callees.pre_condition: state is a State instance whose in-memory collections (events, opencode trace counters, bug summaries) have been populated by prior tail_events, tail_opencode, and scan_bugs calls.
callees.post_condition: Returns a Rich-layout-compatible renderable representing the complete dashboard terminal UI, displaying: per-stage pipeline progress, cumulative token usage and cost, prompt-cache hit rate (derived from state.cache_hit_rate), and current bug-validation verdict counts.
